text: Kubernetes schedules pods onto nodes using the kube-scheduler. Resource requests and limits decide placement and a pod stuck in Pending usually means no node fits its requests.
An Ingress resource routes external HTTP traffic to services inside the cluster. An ingress controller such as nginx implements the rules and handles TLS termination.
Sourdough bread relies on a wild yeast starter. Feed the starter flour and water daily, let the dough ferment slowly, then bake in a hot dutch oven for a crisp crust.
Gradient descent updates model weights by stepping against the gradient of the loss. Learning rate controls step size and too large a value makes training diverge.
Transformers use self-attention to weigh every token against every other token. Positional encodings give the model word order since attention itself is permutation invariant.
BM25 is a sparse ranking function based on term frequency and inverse document frequency with length normalisation. It excels at exact keyword and identifier matches.
Dense retrieval embeds queries and documents into vectors and ranks by cosine similarity. It captures paraphrases and meaning but can miss rare exact terms like error codes.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked lists by summing one over k plus rank for each document. It needs no score normalisation across retrievers and is robust in practice.
A cross-encoder reads the query and a candidate together and outputs a relevance score. It is far more accurate than bi-encoders but too slow to run on the whole corpus.
A Dockerfile defines an image layer by layer. Use a slim base image, copy requirements first to cache dependencies, and expose the port that uvicorn listens on.
FastAPI builds on Pydantic models for request validation. Invalid payloads return a 422 response automatically and dependency injection keeps handlers testable.
LangGraph models an agent as a state graph with nodes and conditional edges. A retry counter stored in state lets a router stop after a maximum number of attempts.
Pytest fixtures provide reusable setup. Parametrize runs one test over many inputs and monkeypatch swaps out network calls so tests stay fast and deterministic.
nDCG rewards placing relevant documents near the top by discounting gain with a log of the rank. MRR looks only at the first relevant hit while recall at k measures coverage.
